text:
Situation: Promethazine hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2023-11-21 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 35 months. Corvale General holds inventory from Zydus Lifesciences Limited (NDC 65841004110) and PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NDC 43063040505). Corvale East has 109 units (12.3 days), Corvale General has two lots totaling 389.99 units (26.2 and 20 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 19 units (9.6 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-11-21. The Zydus plant (FEI 3002984011) received an OAI classification letter on 2019-11-14 (1,468 days before posting) and another on 2016-06-09 (2,721 days before posting). The PD-Rx plant (FEI 1641825) has only VAI inspections, most recently ending 2026-08-20.

Our position: Supply at Corvale Lakeside is below the two-week target. Corvale General holds sufficient stock to support a limited transfer without dropping below two weeks. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, preventing quality assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions, ASCLEMED USA INC., Actavis Pharma, Inc., or Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC only after plant information is obtained — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from alternate suppliers without verified plant inspection history; clinical protocol changes.
